name: Mugon no Shoutaijou
source:
Main heroine lives with her brother Akira holding a detective office with his friend Keiichiro at home. Keiichiro receives email from a mysterious stalker. Who's the sender? How are romantic relations with Keiichiro going to advance? Ten endings are prepared to provide all the answers. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
